description.raw: '''Passive:''' Upon learning ''Chronobreak'' or if its '''current''' cooldown is lower than 4 seconds, '''Ekko''' reveals a time-delayed ''afterimage'' of himself that constantly tracks where he was 4 seconds ago.
description.text: Passive: Upon learning Chronobreak or if its current cooldown is lower than 4 seconds, Ekko reveals a time-delayed afterimage of himself that constantly tracks where he was 4 seconds ago.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Ekko''' enters [[File:Stasis icon.png|20px|link=Invulnerability#Stasis|An icon representing the keyword Stasis (buff)]] [[:Invulnerability#Stasis|stasis]] at the start of the cast time, and afterwards [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|heals]] himself, increased by 0% – 300% (based on health lost in the last 4 seconds)[[Category:Debug]], and [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] to his ''afterimage's'' location at the time of cast over 0.5 seconds. Upon arrival, the stasis ends and he creates an explosion that deals magic damage to nearby enemies.

description3.raw: '''''Ekko''' is immune to all [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|displacements]] during Chronobreak.''
description3.text: Ekko is immune to all displacements during Chronobreak.

notes.raw: * '''Ekko''' will attempt to basic attack the closest target after appearing at the cast location, but can do so quicker if he manually attack commands after the dash, except if [[File:Ekko Phase Dive.png|20xpx|border|link=Ekko#Phase Dive|An icon for Ekko's ability Phase Dive]] [[Ekko#Phase Dive|Phase Dive]] is primed. * The ''afterimage's'' location will explode even if '''Ekko's''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dash]] is interrupted. * A ''link'' can also be seen between the ''afterimage'' and '''Ekko''' that traces along his path. ** The ''link'' follows the same visibility rules as the ''afterimage''. ** Upon activation, '''Ekko''' travels full distance through the ''link'', and thus will detonate [[File:Ekko Parallel Convergence.png|20xpx|border|link=Ekko#Parallel Convergence|An icon for Ekko's ability Parallel Convergence]] [[Ekko#Parallel Convergence|Parallel Convergence]] that the ''link'' passes through. * [[File:Quicksilver Sash item.png|20xpx|border|link=Quicksilver Sash|An icon for the item Quicksilver Sash]] [[Named item effect#Quicksilver|Quicksilver]] incurs a 1-second [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown upon casting ''Chronobreak''. * '''Ekko's''' dash cannot be interrupted by forced movement displacements since he is immune to them. ** This is not to be confused with [[File:Unstoppable icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Displacement_Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Displacement immune]] [[:Crowd control#Displacement_Immunity|displacement immunity]], which resists [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|airborne]] displacements plus a number of other cases. ''Chronobreak'' provides immunity only to displacements that apply [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|airborne]].
notes.text:
Ekko will attempt to basic attack the closest target after appearing at the cast location, but can do so quicker if he manually attack commands after the dash, except if Phase Dive is primed.
The afterimage's location will explode even if Ekko's dash is interrupted.
A link can also be seen between the afterimage and Ekko that traces along his path.
* The link follows the same visibility rules as the afterimage.
* Upon activation, Ekko travels full distance through the link, and thus will detonate Parallel Convergence that the link passes through.
Quicksilver incurs a 1-second  cooldown upon casting Chronobreak.
Ekko's dash cannot be interrupted by forced movement displacements since he is immune to them.
* This is not to be confused with displacement immunity, which resists airborne displacements plus a number of other cases. Chronobreak provides immunity only to displacements that apply airborne.
